# Agentic Life OS (ALOS) — Discoverability Spec

This file defines the active modules, substrates, and agent capabilities of Frank's unified Life Operating System.

## Architecture
- Machine: Yoga Laptop Workstation (Windows)
- SIP Version: 1.1.1
- System Version: 1.2.0

## Master Offering
- Name: Agentic Life OS
- Audience: Founder-operators, creators, and high-agency teams who want one AI-native command spine for work, learning, growth, success, and personal excellence.
- Promise: Turn the repo estate into a private operating system that routes decisions, memories, proof, agent swarms, and recurring loops into visible outcomes.
- Status: private-operator-suite
- Delivery Mode: Git-backed system package, implementation sprint, agent runbooks, and proof-gated operating cadence.
- Public Boundary: Public wrappers may describe the model and starter workflows. Private memory, health, finance, family, unreleased IP, strategy, credentials, and client data stay out of public assets.

### Package: Public Blueprint
- Audience: Builders evaluating the Agentic Life OS model.
- Promise: Understand the architecture, module map, and first workflow without exposing private operating data.
- Delivery Mode: Sanitized docs, examples, and install notes.
- Commercial Status: free
- Support Boundary: Self-serve only.

### Package: Starter Operator Kit
- Audience: Solo founders and creators who want a local command spine.
- Promise: Fork the core profile, run the health checks, and start the daily command loop.
- Delivery Mode: Template repo plus setup checklist.
- Commercial Status: proposed-not-priced
- Support Boundary: Setup support only; no private-data handling.

### Package: Private Life OS Implementation
- Audience: Frank's own operating layer and selected high-trust clients.
- Promise: Connect business, creator, memory, health, wealth, family, and learning loops with bounded agent execution.
- Delivery Mode: Guided implementation sprint with private runbooks.
- Commercial Status: private-only
- Support Boundary: Explicit scope, approval gates, and privacy boundaries required.

### Package: Enterprise Intelligence System
- Audience: Teams needing agent governance, memory, evals, and repo-operating discipline.
- Promise: Deploy the Starlight intelligence substrate and operating doctrine without personal-life modules.
- Delivery Mode: Architecture engagement, repo harness, and validation gates.
- Commercial Status: proposed-not-priced
- Support Boundary: Architecture and enablement; production mutations require named approval.

## Intelligence Systems

### Starlight Intelligence System
- Repo: `Starlight-Intelligence-System`
- Layer: `substrate`
- Public Status: `hybrid`
- Purpose: Memory, provenance, taxonomy, validation, release artifacts, and proof for agentic systems.
- Proof Gate: Run SIS health checks, keep public/private boundaries explicit, and attach evidence paths to releases.

### Starlight Agent Config
- Repo: `starlight-agent-config`
- Layer: `agent-governance`
- Public Status: `private`
- Purpose: Cross-agent skills, policies, task ledgers, install projection, and machine-local operating rules.
- Proof Gate: Run installer doctor before handoff when config projection changes.

### Agentic Ops Hub
- Repo: `agentic-ops-hub`
- Layer: `agent-governance`
- Public Status: `hybrid`
- Purpose: Agent instruction control plane, coordination rules, ASPH handoffs, and repo fleet operating doctrine.
- Proof Gate: Sync/check generated agent rules before release-quality changes.

### Starlight Swarm Runtime
- Repo: `starlight-swarm`
- Layer: `swarm-runtime`
- Public Status: `hybrid`
- Purpose: Queen-worker topology, dry-run safety spine, escalation ladders, and bounded loop execution.
- Proof Gate: Run dry-run, typecheck, and tests; no autonomous live money or production actions.

### AI Capability Registry
- Repo: `ai-capability-registry`
- Layer: `capability-index`
- Public Status: `hybrid`
- Purpose: Index of skills, plugins, activation routes, and agent capability surfaces.
- Proof Gate: Regenerate the capability index after route or plugin changes.

### Hermes Cockpit
- Repo: `hermes-cockpit`
- Layer: `orchestration`
- Public Status: `private`
- Purpose: Operational cockpit for progress reports, Railway-aware estate state, and agent work evidence.
- Proof Gate: Progress collector writes latest evidence without reading secrets.

### Health Intelligence System
- Repo: `health-intelligence-system`
- Layer: `domain-vertical`
- Public Status: `hybrid`
- Purpose: Safety-gated personal health and clinician-prep patterns separated from research-only workflows.
- Proof Gate: Health work keeps human clinical authority and evidence dates explicit.

### Design and Visual Intelligence
- Repo: `starlight-design-intelligence`
- Layer: `quality-gate`
- Public Status: `hybrid`
- Purpose: Design taste, visual QA, motion rubrics, and premium experience validation.
- Proof Gate: Visual work passes screenshots, responsive checks, and the taste rubric before handoff.

## Operating Loops

### Daily Command Loop
- Cadence: daily
- Owner: chief-operator
- Purpose: Select the highest-leverage work, route it to one bounded execution lane, and end with evidence.
- Inputs: global-progress-ledger.json, hermes-cockpit progress reports, repo status
- Outputs: one active priority, bounded task queue, handoff note
- Safety Gate: No production, billing, DNS, secret, or destructive mutation without explicit named approval.

### Business Ops Loop
- Cadence: daily plus weekly review
- Owner: business-command
- Purpose: Turn offers, client delivery, invoices, proof, and launch blockers into a visible operating cadence.
- Inputs: business module, FrankX docs, public site/download surfaces
- Outputs: offer backlog, delivery tasks, proof and revenue blockers
- Safety Gate: Payment setup, public claims, and client commitments require human review.

### Learning And Mastery Loop
- Cadence: weekly
- Owner: learning-systems
- Purpose: Convert research, courses, repos, and experiments into skill upgrades and reusable playbooks.
- Inputs: ai-architect-academy, prompt-library, Starlight memory
- Outputs: learning sprint, skill update, evidence-backed notes
- Safety Gate: Separate source-backed learning from unsupported claims.

### Growth And Distribution Loop
- Cadence: weekly
- Owner: growth-ops
- Purpose: Move audience attention into useful downloads, demos, trust proof, and follow-up workflows.
- Inputs: frankx.ai-vercel-website, analytics reports, release artifacts
- Outputs: campaign brief, download/update checklist, conversion evidence
- Safety Gate: Public pages need claim, privacy, attribution, and checkout readiness checks.

### Creator Production Loop
- Cadence: weekly
- Owner: creator-ops
- Purpose: Turn ideas, music, video, articles, and visual systems into publishable creative assets.
- Inputs: agentic-creator-os, visual-intelligence, Arcanea media repos
- Outputs: asset backlog, publication packet, quality score
- Safety Gate: Rights, attribution, taste, and platform policy checks run before publishing.

### Health And Excellence Loop
- Cadence: daily private log plus weekly review
- Owner: health-intelligence-ops
- Purpose: Support energy, training, nutrition, sleep, recovery, and clinician preparation without replacing professionals.
- Inputs: health package, health-intelligence-system, private records
- Outputs: wellness plan, clinician questions, evidence ledger
- Safety Gate: No diagnosis, treatment, or medication decisions; clinician authority stays explicit.

### Wealth And Capital Loop
- Cadence: weekly
- Owner: investor-ops
- Purpose: Track capital allocation, due diligence, portfolio state, and business cashflow connections.
- Inputs: investor package, business receivables, deal notes
- Outputs: portfolio snapshot, due-diligence queue, decision memo
- Safety Gate: No financial advice or autonomous capital movement.

### Swarm And Evals Loop
- Cadence: per coherent work wave
- Owner: starlight-substrate-ops
- Purpose: Route bounded worker lanes, collect handoffs, validate evidence, and preserve context for the next run.
- Inputs: starlight-swarm, starlight-agent-config, ai-capability-registry
- Outputs: worker queue, eval report, progress ledger update
- Safety Gate: One coordinator owns synthesis; every worker has allowed tools, stop condition, and handoff format.
